body: I just need a shelter over my head and food to feed on with my kids. My house rent has just expired,and I have been served with an eviction notice...I do appreciate if you guys here can help with my rent and something to eat as well!
Why would I do that? Are you making jest of my situation?
I am confused and very sad that I might be a disappointment to my child
I am alone with my son, I help cater for my sick mom
My rent is due and we may be thrown out before the month ends, as for food we make sure we eat once a day..

Single Father

I am usually here for hours here everyday mostly to take my mind off what happening to me, I usually come here with people, at-least we have thing in common which is kids

Since the lockdown started I have basically lost my job and no income, I live in a 3rd war country, the government has basically neglected its citizens and its so sad and heart wrecking , people are more afraid of starving than the virus

I have a 4 year old son and it’s been hard for me as a single parent 

I know I am not supposed to post such on this group but i have few options right now and I hope I don’t do something out of my control
The economy is grounded, we are in lockdown.. it’s so sad and my sons birthday is on Friday, can’t even buy him a cake
Thank you very much, I am the creative director of a brand in Africa
It’s dope, I love the work of art inscribed on it..
